summary: Order the incremental policy/config monotonicity comparators by the number of commits touching each schema (P0.9), starting with profiles/ifx/rules and profiles/ifx/project-map, followed by contracts and profiles/ifx/tech-stack; this refines D13.
rationale: D13 and Plan 06 section 12.4 cited file-change counts from review r3, which ranked policy/g04/bindings second with 8 changes. The P0.9 baseline (analysis/ifx/refactor-baseline/change-frequency.json) shows those 8 changes came from a single commit, while profiles/ifx/rules and profiles/ifx/project-map each changed in 4 commits. Commit count reflects how often an authorization would otherwise be required, so it is the better ordering signal. ci/jobs.json (3 commits) is excluded because P9 replaces it with required-checks.json. D13 itself is unchanged: zero comparators first, unknown changes fail closed.
